method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs; avenue centre reconstructed from the one visible block face plus the avenue width measured on the same sheet, because each sheet is trimmed inside this avenue
why_not_one_block_off: Avenue L is the ONLY avenue that appears on both sheets: sheet 20 runs Sealy/Broadway/K/L west-to-east and is trimmed inside Avenue L at its east edge, and sheet 25 runs L/M/M 1/2/N and is trimmed inside Avenue L at its west edge. The line is lettered on both. Sheet 20: 'AVENUE L.' is printed vertically in the corridor at the sheet's east margin, with '70'' printed in that same roadway at top and bottom; the one visible block face (its west face) reads native 3186.2 off the green ruler, and the sheet's printed area stops at native ~3309. Sheet 25: 'AVENUE L' is printed vertically in the corridor at the sheet's west margin, also marked '70''; its one visible face (the east face) reads native 218.4, and the sheet's printed area starts at native ~13. Because neither sheet shows both faces of this avenue, the reported line is the avenue CENTRE, reconstructed on each sheet by taking the visible face and half the avenue width measured on that same sheet: sheet 20 uses Avenue K, faces 2186.2/2397.2, width 211.0, so 3186.2 + 105.5 = 3291.7; sheet 25 uses Avenue M, faces 1013.2/1226.5, width 213.3, so 218.4 - 106.7 = 111.8. Both reconstructed centres fall inside the printed area of their own sheet (3291.7 < 3309 and 111.8 > 13), i.e. the sheets do overlap across the centre of Avenue L. ADDRESS RUNS. Sheet 20, the 8TH ST run: the block immediately WEST of the line carries '1113 1115 1117 1119 1121 1123' and '1114 1116 1118 1120 1122 1124' - the 1100 block, which is the block between Avenue K and Avenue L. Avenue L's own frontage numbers there are 802 804 806 ... 828 (the 800 block, between 8TH and 9TH ST, inside sheet 20's street range 7-9). Sheet 25, the 9TH ST and 10TH ST runs: the block immediately EAST of the line carries '1201 1203 1205 1207 1209 1211' and '1202 1204 1206 1208 1210 1212' - the 1200 block, which is the block between Avenue L and Avenue M. Avenue L's frontage numbers there are 901 903 ... 927 and then 1001 1003 ... 1021 (the 900 and 1000 blocks, between 9TH and 11TH ST, inside sheet 25's street range 9-12). So the 1100 block dies against this line on sheet 20 and the 1200 block starts from it on sheet 25 - the two halves of the same avenue. ONE BLOCK WEST is excluded: that is Avenue K, lettered 'AVENUE K.' on sheet 20 (centre native 2291.7), which separates the 1000 block from the 1100 block; matching it to sheet 25's Avenue L would put the 1100 block on the wrong side. ONE BLOCK EAST is excluded: that is Avenue M, lettered 'AVENUE M' on sheet 25 (centre native 1119.9), which separates the 1200 block from the 1300 block (the run east of it starts 1302 1304 1306 1308). Avenue M does not appear on sheet 20 at all and Avenue K does not appear on sheet 25 at all, so Avenue L is the only possible match. ALLEY EXCLUDED. The 20 ft mid-block alleys (sheet 20 at native ~2823 west face, sheet 25 faces 583.8/645.6, both dashed and labelled '6" W PIPE' and '20'') do not separate hundred-blocks - 1102-1112 and 1114-1124 on sheet 20 are both the 1100 block, 1201-1211 and 1213-1223 on sheet 25 are both the 1200 block. CANDIDATES REJECTED. Sheet 20 cand#1 (native 2684) and sheet 25 cand#1 (native 736) both run inside a block, not in a corridor. The reported values are ruler-read avenue centres and are NOT among the proposed candidates. UNCERTAINTY: because each centre is reconstructed from one face plus a half-width measured elsewhere on the same sheet, this control carries roughly +/-5 native px of extra uncertainty, against a one-block error of ~1008 px.
